name: Tai Industries Limited
about: Tai Industries Limited engages in trading, marketing and distribution, and retailing of packaged fruit and vegetable products under the DRUK brand. The company's fruit and vegetable products comprising squashes, table and tai sauces, fruit drinks, juices, mango panna, fruit crushes, ketchups, syrups, vinegar white, fruit jams and jellies, orange marmalades, pickles, canned fruits and vegetables, and corn flakes. It also markets and trades in industrial and mineral products and raw materials, such as calcium carbide, charcoal, manganese ore, and ferro-silicon. It serves hotels, clubs, hospitals, nursing homes, bakeries, and confectioneries. Tai Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Kolkata, India.
